suspect.0.feature1: Won't be seen anywhere without her ruby necklace.
suspect.0.occupation: Once a secret agent for Monaco's intelligence bureau
suspect.10.feature1: Always wears a silver necklace with a single diamond.
suspect.10.feature2: She loves cooking but is never hungry.
suspect.10.occupation: Geography teacher who uses classroom maps to plan international jewel heists
suspect.11.feature1: Always carries a floppy disk containing his latest stolen secrets.
suspect.11.feature2: Survives on black coffee and refuses to eat anything he cannot order anonymously.
suspect.11.occupation: Cybersecurity consultant by day, notorious data thief by night
suspect.12.feature1: Always wears a crimson silk scarf.
suspect.12.feature2: Speaks twelve languages fluently and can lie convincingly in every one.
suspect.12.occupation: Former diplomatic interpreter turned multilingual international spy
suspect.13.feature1: Always carries a piece of rose quartz, claiming it channels the energy of the mountains.
suspect.13.feature2: Loves bureaucracy and refuses to commit a crime without completing the proper forms in triplicate.
suspect.13.occupation: Bank records manager who alters account histories for international fugitives
suspect.14.feature1: Always wears a gold brooch engraved with the scales of justice.
suspect.14.feature2: Quotes imaginary laws whenever anyone questions his authority.
suspect.14.hobby: Cooking — he only ever makes rice and minced meat, and insists it's the finest dish in the world
suspect.14.occupation: Fake lawyer who represents international fugitives using forged credentials
suspect.15.feature1: Always carries the newest and most expensive mobile phone.
suspect.15.feature2: Orders the most expensive sushi on every first date but always disappears before the bill arrives.
suspect.15.occupation: Former dating-app consultant who steals the identities of his wealthiest clients
suspect.16.feature1: Wears a gold crown everywhere and insists on being addressed as "Your Majesty."
suspect.16.feature2: Claims to have summited the world's most treacherous peaks, but has never been seen climbing anything steeper than his hotel's grand staircase.
suspect.16.hobby: Mountain climbing—mostly so he can be photographed at the summit
suspect.16.occupation: Self-proclaimed royal adviser who sells counterfeit titles of nobility
suspect.17.auto: Jade-green vintage Vespa with a matching sidecar
suspect.17.feature1: Carries a black-and-teal folding fan concealing a compartment for stolen documents.
suspect.17.feature2: Drinks only jasmine tea and refuses anything served outside fine porcelain.
suspect.17.occupation: Former museum conservator who replaces priceless manuscripts with flawless forgeries
suspect.18.feature1: Constantly checks a gold pocket watch engraved with dozens of false identities.
suspect.18.feature2: Eats breakfast precisely at midnight and refuses any egg that is not perfectly circular.
suspect.18.occupation: Former railway timetable inspector who manufactures airtight alibis for international fugitives
suspect.19.feature1: Never travels without a compact marine radio tuned to private channels.
suspect.19.feature2: Keeps a little black book of aliases, ports, and conveniently forgotten anniversaries.
suspect.19.occupation: Luxury-yacht broker who courts wealthy clients before sailing away with their valuables
suspect.20.feature1: Carries a palm-sized flavor scanner that is really an encrypted radio.
suspect.20.feature2: Refuses to season anything until a stopwatch reaches exactly sixty seconds.
suspect.20.occupation: Food-science celebrity who smuggles stolen microchips inside self-heating recipe cases
suspect.21.feature1: Carries a carved wooden chess knight that he claims brings luck.
suspect.21.feature2: Can identify a century from the smell of old paper, but never the rightful owner.
suspect.21.occupation: Disgraced auction cataloguer who swaps national relics for convincing replicas
suspect.3.feature1: Wears a diamond ring as big as a grapefruit.
suspect.3.feature2: Races around the countryside hunting for good Mexican food.
suspect.4.feature1: A mermaid tattoo marks his right thumb.
suspect.4.occupation: Retired pro hockey player turned gambler
suspect.5.feature1: Sports a five-carat ring on his pinky.
suspect.5.feature2: Keeps a 6'8" valet called "The Asp" and can down his own weight in tacos.
suspect.6.feature1: Favors rumpled trenchcoats and snap-brim fedoras. Brown-eyed, with a moustache.
suspect.6.feature2: Big on Mexican food; his Crimefighter's ring never leaves his finger.
suspect.7.feature1: His calling card: a diamond stickpin left at every crime scene.
suspect.7.feature2: A flawlessly dressed jet-setter with a taste for Mexican food.
suspect.8.feature1: An odd Ukrainian tattoo covers his right shoulder.
suspect.8.feature2: Enjoys lobster dinners, cartoons, and everything about large marsupials.
suspect.8.occupation: Claims the old Czarist throne as his own
suspect.9.feature1: An eagle tattoo spreads across her left bicep.
suspect.9.feature2: Cooks gourmet seafood; devoted to health and fitness.
